name: Valens Semiconductor Ltd.
blurb: Valens Semiconductor is an Israeli fabless semiconductor company founded in 2006 that designs chips enabling high-bandwidth, long-reach connectivity over standard cables. Its flagship HDBaseT technology delivers simultaneous 4K/8K video, audio, Ethernet, USB, and power over a single cable, serving enterprise AV, education, industrial, and digital signage markets. The company also has an automotive segment targeting in-vehicle connectivity for advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) and autonomous driving applications. With ~233 employees and trailing revenue of roughly $70.7 million, it competes in the broader semiconductor connectivity market against companies such as Parade Technologies and Analogix.
recent: Valens reported Q1 2026 earnings on May 13, 2026, with trailing twelve-month revenue up ~11.9% year-over-year to $70.66 million, though the company remains unprofitable with a net loss of $31.57 million. The stock surged 9.26% on earnings day to close at $2.95, continuing a recovery from its 52-week low of $1.10 hit on March 30, 2026. As of the May 14 pre-market, shares were trading around $3.01, and analysts carry a consensus Strong Buy rating with a $3.50 price target.
